name: admitting-a-formation-request
description: Use when a sovereign settlement offers an exact office for professional formation; verify its identity, snapshot, candidate policy, protected context, assessment law, price, and bounded grant before admitting it to the Academy.
preconditions: the offer has crossed the Academy boundary as a receiver-local carrier
the customer and office snapshot are resolvable
the requested grant withholds customer-territory mutation
postconditions: one FormationRequest is appended or one typed FormationRefusal is appended
the admitted request binds exact office and protected-context digests
no appointment or customer mutation authority is inferred
